ManHead.obj  <- "Man"  https://poly.pizza/m/3w4Bgw7Phn

Modifications (DESYNC): converted from GLB to OBJ+MTL, cropped to the head (top ~25% of the figure), cigarette removed,
rotated to face +Z, texture palette colours baked into per-material Kd colours. Used as the Architect's face.
